provenance.note: Where the substance enters the water, as a Point: the pick's {coordinates, name} verbatim, a (lon, lat) pair, 'lat,lon', a point layer. Geocode a place name first. Its name becomes the tracer's name, and on a river with no domain supplied it is also the seed the reach is walked downstream from [supplied on this invocation]
Along-domain release position, 0=inflow..1=outflow; the source must sit strictly INSIDE the domain, never on a boundary [supplied on this invocation]
Finite pulse injection window [supplied on this invocation]

Target element edge or cell length the domain is resolved at. The granularity is the USER's lever: no sizing rung derives an edge from a channel nobody surveyed, so the number the run meshes at is either yours or this labeled default [supplied on this invocation]

The moment the scenario is read at - an ISO date or datetime ('2026-08-20' or '2026-08-20T06:00:00Z'), from phrasing like 'during last Tuesday's storm'. Each source keeps its own retention, and a request deeper than one refuses typed [supplied on this invocation]
Solve sizing class - how many cores the solve is partitioned across. An engine that runs on one core says so on the card [declared constant default]

Vertical datum this run counts every elevation from - the bed under it and the level over it. A source published on another frame reaches this one through a measured offset, and a pair nobody publishes an offset between refuses by name [declared constant default]
not supplied; the tracer is CONSERVATIVE - it dilutes and advects and nothing removes it
